name: Sidie Hollow County Park, Boat Landing Campground
waterfront_evidence: Split from 3585 2026-11-17. Esri World_Imagery read 2026-11-17 at 43.5382,-90.9502 (130 m half-width) and 43.5384,-90.9525 (140 m, toward the lake), both rendered: the south row (106-116) sits at ~43.5379-43.5380 on grass that ends at a continuous treeline ~20-30 m south; Sidie Hollow Creek, which the county map (https://cms8.revize.com/revize/vernoncountywi/Park%20Overview%20&%20Detailed%20Camping.pdf, read 2026-11-17) draws south of that row, runs under the canopy and is not visible, so trees screen it from every site. The lake's east tip and its marsh lie ~160 m west of the westernmost sites (116/117), past the boat-launch lot. No site within ~50 m of water over open ground -> not waterfront. DEM 288 m at the inflow end of the lake, upstream of the dam. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Vernon County Sidie Hollow page (https://www.vernoncountywi.gov/departments/land_and_water_conservation/parks_and_forests/sidie_hollow.php, read 2026-11-17): '85 campsites' with 'full hookup RV sites', reservations via Campspot; 'please visit our camp hosts at site #9 of the boat landing campground area'. County detailed camping map (https://cms8.revize.com/revize/vernoncountywi/Park%20Overview%20&%20Detailed%20Camping.pdf, read 2026-11-17): 'Boat Landing Campground S5184 Boat Landing Road' sites 101-125 (full hookup 106-122, electric and water 123-125, rustic 101-105), with its own registration, restrooms, showers, water, playground and shelter. The county's Campspot engine (2026-10-13 capture) lists the Full Hook Up and Electric + Water types to 40 ft with Motorhome among the rig types. A real county drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits; it sits ~1.3 km from the park's Main area on its own road.
note: The full-hookup campground of Vernon County's Sidie Hollow park near Viroqua, at the east end of the 38-acre lake by the boat launch, on its own road about 1.3 km from the park's Main area. The camp hosts stay here (site #9 on the county page) and sell ice and firewood. --Claude

sites.note: 17 full-hookup (106-122), 3 electric-and-water (123-125) and 5 rustic (101-105). Campspot lists all but one of the park's 35 rustic sites under 23 ft.

facilities.note: The park's dump station is in the Main campground area on County Road XX.

booking.note: Advance (online) reservations need 2 nights and close 3 days before arrival; from each Wednesday unreserved sites go first-come for that weekend. Check-in noon, check-out 11 am. The caretaker's office in the Main campground area also takes reservations.

fees.note: Vernon County 2026: electric and water $40 a night (123-125), full hookups $55 (106-122); rustic sites $20 (mostly under 23 ft). A full week is six nights' charge (seventh night free); 30-day rates $600-825, a full season on a full-hookup site $2,000. $8 reservation/processing fee, kept on cancellation. Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout.
